paragraphs: [He reported] in the name of Rav, in Sanhedrin, chapter 3, halakhah 3; Hyman identifies him as R' Abba bar Avina. See his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The identification with Abba bar Avina is Hyman’s own statement.

The actual Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:3 paragraph has untitled Rava bar Bina in the name of Rav. Hyman’s identification with the separate R' Abba bar Avina pointer remains his assertion; that uncollated title stays abbreviated, and no authority or teacher identity is bound. The current note remains verbatim.
